claims: Embark Studios is not shutting down ARC Raiders.
Embark Studios is closing the PlayStation 4 version of The Finals on March 18, 2026.
ARC Raiders is currently moving forward as a paid PvPvE extraction shooter with planned long-term support.
ARC Raiders was originally announced as a free-to-play model.
The Finals will cease support on PS4 with the start of Season 10 on March 18, 2026.
The Finals will cease support on PS4 due to difficulties in optimizing for older hardware.
Sources on Facebook say ARC Raiders pivoted from a pure PvE game to a PvPvE extraction shooter after testing indicated the original format was not engaging.
Embark Studios previously announced a 10-year plan for ARC Raiders content.
